title: Sportico副主编：篮网历史包袱，难获纽约球迷认同
speaker: Evan Novi Williams

segments.en: You know, they came within, you know, the last 14 years, they're not new to the NBA.
segments.zh: 他们在过去14年内搬来，但并非NBA新军。

segments.en: They came with a lot of, you know, history in New Jersey, but the thing is they kind of left that history behind actually in the way that they marketed the team.
segments.zh: 他们带着新泽西的历史而来，但营销球队时却把那段历史抛在了脑后。

segments.en: So they don't have as many natural New York fans as they would probably like.
segments.zh: 所以他们并没有像期望中那样拥有大量纽约本地粉丝。
